experiences.description: Leading a "Buy and Build" platform from a single service/single geography to a national footprint serving 47 states. Established scale through 9 brick and mortar acquisitions/tuck-ins across 6 new geographies, organic growth through measured KPIs, expanded service offerings and full systems integration.  Full back-office HQ development to facilitate implementation of NetSuite ERP, Salesforce, Operations software(s), Payroll, and Concur.  Established and nurtured a company culture focused on safety and sustainability.

Winter Services is a 100% organic growth-focused, specialty contractor providing essential services in snow and ice control on a national level through numerous brick and mortar locations and a fortified national contractor network.  Our goal is to leverage our efficiencies to provide continual value for our broad base of government and commercial clients using proven business management methodology and a keen focus on company core values.

As a Fortune 500 company, Kohl's exerted its dominance in the mainstream home and fashion categories for households across the country.  The Director of Merchant Marketing is responsible for outlining the strategic path for company marketing spend in all advertising mediums across hundreds of national and private labels brands.  That plan is then presented and approved on a quarterly basis through senior executive leadership and implemented across multiple major and niche advertising agencies, in multiple languages, on both coasts.
